description: Liberia - Populated Settlements is a dataset listed in energydata.info, an open data portal for energy in developing countries under the section "Demographics", published or maintained by Shaky Sherpa (Columbia University Earth Institute). Liberia census population dataset from 2007-2008 created by Liberia Institute of Statistics and Geo-Information Services (LISGIS). The dataset contains a list of all the settlements that are geo-located(coordinates in UTM projection) and have attributes with their administrative units and population data ( total, male, female and number of households). Coverage: Liberia. It has 2 files in GeoJSON, SHP. The portal files it under Demographics. The portal gives 2008 as the release date. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. Suitability for infrastructure simulation has not been checked. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-energydata-info-world-bank.
